The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e8a9907a3ac0811), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Use the nested partitions and limiting convention of Section 2, with the exponents chosen above. Let A = L b∈CB Ab, where the one-particle operators Ab on L2(b) are identical in local coordinates and satisfy 0 ≤ Ab ≤ W. Their cosine matrices may be complex Hermitian. For every normalized bosonic ground vector, 1 V ⟨dΓ(A)⟩ = 1 vb X p̸=0 (Ab)ppFα(p) + o(1), (Ab)pp = ⟨up, Abup⟩. (4.13) The error is uniform in the ground vector and in all the indicated operators, which may depend on the scales. The same formula and uniformity hold when Ab = WCbW and Cb is any complex contraction, identical in local coordinates. Both assertions hold uniformly for simultaneous translates of the nested partitions.
